name: le.seo
description: Marketing optimisation for a collection of seeds: one voice, one goal, one ordered tree of links.

pitches.reader: A short, ordered tree of the family — chosen for who you are and what you came to do.
pitches.grower: The tree that says which start to install, in the order a grower should meet them.
pitches.maintainer: Every destination carries a voice, a goal and a rung, and the order is a stated rule.
pitches.packager: The giardiniera isotope: an assortment served in one order, and the address is the pitch.
